part-I__sec-27.heading: Restricted disclosure
part-I__sec-27.html:
In this section, disclose means to give access to protected information outside the agency.

A person must not disclose protected information to a foreign entity.

part-I__sec-30.heading: General use
part-I__sec-30.html: A person may disclose information with consent. An authorised officer may be asked to attend.

part-I__sec-41.heading: Inspections
part-I__sec-41.html:
In this section, authorised officer means a person appointed in writing to inspect premises.

An authorised officer may enter the premises at any reasonable time.
